thread:
maria: CI is red on main — es-e2e is failing repeatedly on the mock-es startup. https://ci.redwood.example/builds/5123
cj: Looking now. Which test suite is failing? the indexing one?
maria: Yep, the indexing/search integration tests. Failures show the ES node never binds properly and tests time out. Log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:56Z] ERROR org.elasticsearch.bootstrap: bind_exception: Address already in use [::]:9200
[2026-03-17T12:34:57Z] WARN  org.elasticsearch.node: node not ready, retrying startup
[2026-03-17T12:35:25Z] ERROR o.e.h.HttpServerTransport: Failed to bind to [::]:9200
```
devex: We saw something similar in canary yesterday after the es image bumped. Could be the new image starting slower or port collisions in the CI sandbox. @oncall-bot can you rerun just the es-e2e job please?
oncall-bot: Scheduled rerun of job es-e2e (build #5123) — started.
raj: If rerun fixes it it's likely a flake. If it repeats, let's bisect commits between 1f4a..b2c9 (those touched the infra/test harness). Also worth checking the docker-compose healthcheck — it might return success before ES is fully ready. Try increasing initial_delay to 30s or add an explicit wait-for-health step.
cj: I'll try adding ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms256m -Xmx512m to the job env to rule out slow JVM cold start. Can someone launch a rerun with that override?
maria: I kicked off a rerun with the env override via the CI UI: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/5123/rerun — keeping it isolated for now.
oncall-bot: Rerun started: containers are spinning up.
devex: Rerun still failing — same bind_exception. New log shows two ES processes trying to bind in the same runner:
```
org.elasticsearch.http.BindHttpException: Failed to bind to [9300]
Caused by: java.net.BindException: Address already in use (EADDRINUSE)
Stacktrace: ...
```
raj: That looks like a leftover ES process from a previous job not being cleaned up. I'll add a pre-start cleanup step to the test harness to kill any lingering java/elasticsearch processes and free ports. I'll open a tiny PR and ping for reviews.
maria: Please drop the PR link when ready. I'll hold merges to main lightly until we confirm the fix — don't want a queue of failing runs.
raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6789 — adds `pkill -f elasticsearch || true` and a `sleep 2` before bringing up the cluster. cc @cj @devex
cj: quick skim, LGTM. let's run CI on the PR, then merge if green. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Merge queued; maintainers and CI notified.
